name: Gurt
description: The Lost Heir, alive: the daughter of the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]] and the [[Sultana of Caryes|Sultana]], travelling as Gurt, assistant to [[General Anailís]], wherever she goes. A mess of frizzy dark hair, dyed from the silver of the Miurnan high court; seemingly blind, and never without sunglasses, which hide the purple eyes of Aphemenosta's matrilineal line. Together the two would prove her parentage beyond reasonable doubt.
